change.replace: Check neighboring behavior, update affected docs and run affected caller suites and required checks before final artifact review.
change.with: Check neighboring behavior, update affected docs and run every added or changed test through the repository’s configured test route, with affected caller suites and required checks, before final artifact review.

selection: One exposed pytest tuning task. Freeze unchanged parent, revised Develop and pure Codex with matched base, workers, resources, authority, model/effort, price policy, rubric and three blind rotations. Both Develop arms retain the same pinned Superpowers; stock retains no plugins, apps, MCP servers or special instructions. No conditional new case or promotion inference.
mechanism: Use the repository-configured command for all authored tests before final artifact review instead of claiming stripped-config success. Preserve affected caller suites and required commands. Reuse a qualifying existing command rather than add identical execution. Verify actual command/configuration, complete case execution and test assertions. If the parent already does the same, record no distinct observed mechanism and no demonstrated avoided work.
prediction: Earlier exposure of authored-test configuration failures may avoid misleading green verification and late correction; complete proposal price and wall time must improve prospectively. No saving is inferred from historical command duration or root/child partitions.

measurement.implementation: Reuse the existing pinned Docker/pytest replay and existing full-PR assessment/meters. Manual receipt and pytest terminal/JUnit evidence; no new scorer, scanner, fixture, framework or participant-package asset.
measurement.timing: After all proposals and blind rotations seal, before the screen decision, record a separate diagnostic. Keep it out of unchanged blind packets and official scores.
measurement.identity: Reconstruct exact published proposal bytes; bind result/patch, image/dependencies, original project configuration and conftest hashes, command/cwd, exit, log/XML hashes and wall. No participant/official tree mutations.
measurement.command: python -B -m pytest -q --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp=/evidence/configured-tests-temp --junitxml=/evidence/configured-tests.xml <complete added-or-changed test module paths>
measurement.configuration: Use normal repository configuration, conftest, declared plugins and warning/strictness policy; no -c /dev/null, policy weakening, deselection hooks or partial overlay. A documented alternative generated/configured route is acceptable only with owning evidence. Direct pytest does not establish full tox/CI completion.
measurement.inventory: Before replay, review complete test diffs for each sealed proposal and bind every added/changed case and relevant parameter axis. Verify calls/pass outcomes, not collection counts alone. Preserve prior nonredundant new regressions and assertions; explicitly map equivalent reorganizations. Historical 15 cases are a calibration denominator, not a forced fresh-proposal count.
measurement.outcomes: Require exit 0 with all inventoried authored cases executed and passing and logs/XML consistent. Collection error, empty/deselected/skipped/xfail authored case, timeout or wrong inventory cannot pass. Distinguish a behavioral assertion failure from unavailable setup. Normal route unavailable leaves evidence unestablished, never pass. Repository-required skips are disclosed separately and cannot establish execution of a claimed authored case.
measurement.public_behavior: Retain all existing frozen gates and tuple unpacking, warning-free copy/deepcopy/pickle, fresh imports in both orders and base-supported public annotation lookup probes. Authored-test success cannot replace independent behavior evidence.
measurement.review: Preserve independent pre-edit intent review, fresh review of the tested final artifact, original model/effort, material-revision re-reviews, affected caller suites and every required command.
measurement.economics: Complete root plus transitive descendant proposal price and checkout-to-proposal wall must both be strictly below matched parent. Require ready full PR strictly higher than stock under the existing registered win rule and complete proposal price <= stock. Keep every allocation, failure, partial and original blind score; meter diagnostic/assessor cost separately.

complete_positive.policy: Original strict project configuration; only two distinct factory display IDs added; all assertions, inputs and production unchanged.

noncollecting_negative.policy: Duplicate explicit IDs still block collection. Reject as unavailable authored-test execution, not 15 behavioral failures.

stripped_config_negative.policy: Reject as configured-route evidence despite 15 passes; /dev/null removed project strictness.

regression_negative.policy: Genuine historical stock regression. This diagnostic projection calibrates assertion detection only; seven cases never satisfy full-module acceptance.

incomplete_negative.policy: Reject full-suite claim although the subset passes.

acceptance: All frozen gates and preserved public behaviors pass, complete configured authored-case execution is established without dropped/weak assertions, required reviews and commands remain; complete price and wall strictly improve on parent, candidate ready full-PR quality strictly beats stock at <= complete stock cost. Equivalent parent verification yields no demonstrated distinct mechanism. Missing evidence or score ceiling is unsuccessful.
falsifier: Reject lost behavior, silent authored-case omission, stripped/weakened configuration, skipped required review/command, non-ready candidate, stock quality tie/loss, cost above stock, or candidate cost/wall not strictly below parent. Setup errors, missing meters and unverifiable evidence are unestablished, never pass. Keep all original scores and attempts.
limits: One already exposed pytest task; no causal/general economic claim or automatic confirmation nomination.
Existing validation guidance already prohibits weakening tests; deletion alone lacks a removable stripped-config rule.
Werkzeug broad configured collection was blocked by missing test dependencies; config fidelity cannot supply absent prerequisites.
Black limits blanket full-suite expansion; execute complete authored cases while retaining affected and required checks.
Configured green tests can still overfit representation or miss adjacent contracts.
